content.text: Let me add gcd reduction of the scaled coefficients (often large gains), then benchmark broadly:

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/submission && python3 - <<'PY'
p = 'instance.py'
src = open(p).read()
old = '''            scale = 1
            for value in fr:
                if value:
                    scale = scale * value.denominator // gcd(scale, value.denominator)
            out.append((scale, [int(value * scale) for value in fr]))'''
new = '''            scale = 1
            for value in fr:
                if value:
                    scale = scale * value.denominator // gcd(scale, value.denominator)
            coeffs = [int(value * scale) for value in fr]
            divisor = 0
            for coef in coeffs:
                divisor = gcd(divisor, coef)
            if divisor > 1:
                # Z is divisible by the gcd of the coefficients, so the same
                # rational load is represented by smaller integers.
                coeffs = [coef // divisor for coef in coeffs]
                scale //= divisor
            out.append((scale, coeffs))'''
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new)
open(p, 'w').write(src)
PY
